svg.title: Context Engine Level 4 and Level 5 Architecture
svg.desc: Level 4 pipeline: 5 inputs through Kalman Filter, EWM Z-Score, IC Validation, PCA to Context Score. Level 5 adds alternative data, ML ensemble, IC monitoring, and SHAP output.
svg.text: STAGE 1 — KALMAN FILTER (applied per signal independently)
Extracts true underlying state · Removes daily noise before it enters the context engine
Exponential decay weighting (span=60) · Recent data weighted higher · Captures regime shifts faster
z = (x − ewm_mean) / ewm_std · All signals in σ-units · Comparable across data sources
IC = corr(signal_t , forward_return_{t+5d}) · Rolling 6-month window · Computed per signal
weight_i = IC_i / Σ(IC_all) · Low-IC signals auto down-weighted · Proves edge before combining
5 correlated inputs → 3 orthogonal components · Eliminates real yields / DXY overlap
IC-weighted sum of 3 PCA components · Single value · Feeds Regime Classifier
LEVEL 5 — WORLD CLASS UPGRADES (delta from L4)
NLP news sentiment on gold headlines
Satellite mine output · Physical gold flows
Streaming tick-level feeds — not daily batch
ML ENSEMBLE REPLACES PCA + IC WEIGHTING
Rolling IC recalculated weekly per signal
Signal retired if IC < 0.01 for 60 days
Detects signal decay before drawdown hits
L4: single score → L5: score + CI
SHAP: which signal drives today's score
